_note: Config for scripts/resample_eval_sets.py (issue #56, ADR 0038): offline stratified resampling of per-item decomposition scores. Each arm is run ONCE over a population (the full answerable dev split, musique_dev_full), decoding is greedy and few-shot retrieval is per question, so a question's score does not depend on which sample it sits in; K random stratified samples are then scored from the per-item files with the evaluator's own aggregation (scripts/musique_decompositions_evaluator.py::_aggregate), overall and per hop. Draw d (0-based) uses its own random.Random(seed + d), drawing per_hop ids without replacement from each hop's sorted population, hops in the listed order; the draws depend only on the population ids, so the SAME K draws are reused for every arm (paired). The pinned 600 (ADR 0007, read from datasets.<pinned_ids_template_key>) is scored as one more subset and placed in each distribution as a mid-rank percentile: 100 * (#draws below + 0.5 * #draws tied) / K. percentiles are numpy's default (linear interpolation). Ranks are direction-aware (1 = best; ged and the two decomposition-rate terms are lower-is-better, read from the evaluator) with ties sharing the best rank (competition ranking). per_hop may be overridden on the command line for a smoke run; the override is recorded. POPULATION: every arm's per-item file must carry the evaluator's evaluation_set record (scored with --eval-set) for the same named set with matches_named_set true, and the population must equal that set's ids; --allow-unnamed-population is the recorded smoke-run opt-out. CAVEAT (the lead's wording, 2026-10-14): draws are without replacement from finite hop strata, so the across-draw SD is shrunk by the finite-population correction sqrt(1 - n/N), about 0.92 / 0.86 / 0.71 at 2 / 3 / 4 hops for n = 200 of musique_dev_full (N = 1252 / 760 / 405); the outputs report an FPC-corrected SD beside the raw SD, and the figures plot the raw spread. Overlap between draws does not shrink the band; it only correlates the K draws, which limits how precisely the band is estimated. The spread is question-sampling variation only (greedy decoding). The diamond is the pinned-600 subset RECOMPUTED from this run; --committed-pinned records each arm's committed pinned value and the difference.

figures._note: Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette, assigned to arms in the order they are passed on the command line (one color per arm in every figure). The heatmap uses a sequential single-hue colormap. Sizes are in inches at the stated dpi, chosen to stay readable when a figure fills a slide.
